335:t_1:166.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$バアル$$... So its appearance really was the first step toward the universe's collapse.」

335:t_1:167.en:
$$トライア$$
「Rather than the first step, it seems to be the very means of bringing about that collapse.」

335:t_1:168.en:
$$トライア$$
「Though we still don't know how the extinction of living beings relates to the universe's rebirth.」

335:t_1:169.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「But now we understand part of the actual process behind what was only an abstract concept of cosmic collapse.」

335:t_1:170.en:
$$桂$$
「So basically, if we don't lose to $$バアル$$, the universe won't collapse.」

335:t_1:171.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Yes... $$ノリコ$$'s world apparently survived that way, by destroying the nest of the $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

335:t_1:172.en:
$$カレン$$
「Then we can protect the universe too, as long as we don't lose to $$バアル$$!」

335:t_1:173.en:
$$トライア$$
「Probably, but it's too early to celebrate. The ruins also contained these words.」

335:t_1:174.en:
$$トライア$$
「Those who open the door to $$シンカ$$ confront the universe's end... And that will become the power to transcend the true end that will come...」

335:t_1:176.en:
$$トライア$$
「Twelve thousand years... After ten thousand repetitions, the universe meets its true end...」

335:t_1:177.en:
$$トライア$$
「That is the final battle... The force that seeks to vanish and the force that seeks to exist clash with everything at stake...」

335:t_1:178.en:
$$トライア$$
「It will engulf every parallel world in existence.」

335:t_1:180.en:
$$モーム$$
「Twelve thousand years, ten thousand times... So that's a hundred and twenty million years?」

335:t_1:181.en:
$$トライア$$
「That must be what it means. ...The passage ends with these words.」

335:t_1:182.en:
$$トライア$$
「The power to transcend that true end is... the pinnacle of $$シンカ$$... In other words, the power of God...」

335:t_1:183.en:
$$トライア$$
「God and the Devil... The battle between higher lifeforms and $$バアル$$... That is the means to transcend the end...」

335:t_1:184.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「The battle between God and the Devil...」

335:t_1:185.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「The $$ミケーネ神$$s said something similar...」

335:t_1:186.en:
$$トライア$$
「Some other records remain, but we're still analyzing those.」

335:t_1:187.en:
$$トライア$$
「They contain complicated concepts: a higher mission, emissaries of God... Some of it is a bit beyond us.」

335:t_1:188.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「But whatever that true end may be, discovering the mechanism of cosmic collapse is a major gain.」

335:t_1:189.en:
$$桂$$
「The question is whether Earth as it is now can beat $$バアル$$.」

335:t_1:190.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$バアル$$... humanity's natural enemy... It is said to come from the galactic center.」

335:t_1:191.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And according to the data $$レド$$ gave us, $$サイデリアル$$'s main force is deployed at the galactic center.」

335:t_1:192.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Are they fighting $$バアル$$ there?」

335:t_1:194.en:
$$マオ$$
「Then the $$次元力|lc$$ they extract on Earth is probably for that battle too.」

335:t_1:196.en:
$$トライア$$
「They aren't the only ones fighting $$バアル$$. If they'd said so honestly, Earth might have cooperated.」

335:t_1:197.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But $$サイデリアル$$ chose invasion.」

335:t_1:198.en:
$$カレン$$
「I have no desire to cooperate with people like that.」

335:t_1:199.en:
$$トライア$$
「You're quite right. ...I'll keep analyzing the records. I'll tell you if I find anything else.」

335:t_1:200.en:
$$トライア$$
「Countering $$バアル$$ matters too, but first, deal with the $$サイデリアル$$ right in front of you.」

335:t_1:202.en:
$$桂$$
「It'll be tough with this force, but I don't intend to give up.」

335:t_1:203.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's the spirit. I'm counting on you all.」

335:t_1:204.en:
$$トライア$$
「If you see that debt-ridden drifter, tell him to hurry up and pay me back.」

335:t_1:206.en:
$$デュオ$$
「She must mean $$クロウ$$. Who else could it be?」

335:t_1:207.en:
$$カトル$$
「So $$クロウ$$... still hasn't paid off his debt from the $$再世戦争$$.」

335:t_1:210.en:
$$研究員$$
「I had no idea Dr. $$メグミ・ラクナルド$$ had a child.」

335:t_1:211.en:
$$研究員$$
「I heard she died in an accident in her thirties. Her papers inspired me to go into research myself.」

335:t_1:212.en:
$n
「...As I told Dr. $$トライア$$, I... barely remember my mom, so...」

335:t_1:214.en:
$n
「...I have to service $$ジェニオン$$, so please excuse me.」

335:t_1:216.en:
$$デュオ$$
「That was the first time we've seen his hard mode in a while.」

335:t_1:218.en:
$$マオ$$
「He's shut other people out before, but this time it's different.」

335:t_1:219.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I sensed a wall in a darker, deeper place... in the deepest part of his heart.」

335:t_1:220.en:
$$研究員$$
「...I'm sorry... It seems I asked about something I shouldn't have.」

335:t_1:221.en:
$$マオ$$
「Don't worry about it. We'll look after $n.」

335:t_1:222.en:
$$クルツ$$
「That's right. Won't we, Miss $$スズネ$$?」

335:t_1:225.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Oh... I'm sorry... Dr. $$トライア$$'s story made my head spin...」

335:t_1:226.en:
$$宗介$$
「Your love of the occult really runs deep, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

335:t_1:227.en:
$$研究員$$
「But I was surprised. The doctor studied archaeology as well as super-dimensional physics...」

335:t_1:228.en:
$$研究員$$
「So Dr. $$トライア$$ was influenced by Dr. $$メグミ・ラクナルド$$ too.」

335:t_1:231.en:
$$カレン$$
「Do you know a girl named $$エスター・エルハス$$?」

335:t_1:232.en:
$$研究員$$
「You mean $$エスター$$, the $$次元獣$$ Buster. We often went out for lunch when she was at this lab.」

335:t_1:235.en:
$$カレン$$
「Did something happen to $$エスター$$?!」

335:t_1:239.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「This is an area where Imperial and Earth forces are evenly matched.」

335:t_1:240.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ is coming...!」

335:t_2:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「But what on earth for...?」
